map.依据 FIGO（2015）/NICE（2017）标准，评估胎心基线、变异、加速与: Per FIGO (2015)/NICE (2017) standards, assess baseline, variability, accelerations and decelerations to classify CTG and advise management.

map.基线 110–160 bpm 正常；变异 5–25 bpm 正常；加速 ≥ 2/: Baseline 110-160 bpm normal; variability 5-25 bpm normal; accelerations >=2/20min normal
map.晚期/延长/正弦减速为病理性；可疑 1 项或病理性 ≥ 1 项 → 可疑/病理性: Late/prolonged/sinusoidal decelerations are pathological; 1 suspicious or >=1 pathological -> suspicious/pathological CTG.
map.💡 FIGO 三分类：正常（全部正常特征）、可疑（1 项异常）、病理（≥2 项异: 💡 FIGO three-tier: normal (all normal), suspicious (1 abnormal), pathological (>=2 abnormal or any critical feature).

map.出现病理图形应立即按产科急救流程处理。: Pathological patterns need immediate obstetric emergency management.
map.📚 深度解析：胎儿心率基线判读: 📚 In-Depth: Fetal Heart Rate Baseline Interpretation
map.产时/远程胎心监护看基线心率是否正常。: Intrapartum/remote monitoring checks whether the baseline is normal.
map.结合变异与加速综合判断。: Combine with variability and accelerations for overall judgment.
map.胎心基线 140 次/分（正常 110–160），变异中等、有加速，判为正常 C: Baseline 140 bpm (normal 110-160), moderate variability, accelerations -> normal CTG.
map.基线 175 次/分（>160），持续 >10 分钟为胎儿心动过速，需排查母体发: Baseline 175 bpm (>160) for >10 min is fetal tachycardia; rule out maternal fever, infection or fetal hypoxia.
map.正常胎心基线范围？: What is the normal baseline range?
map.110–160 次/分；<110 为心动过缓、>160 为心动过速，持续 10: 110-160 bpm; <110 bradycardia, >160 tachycardia, sustained >10 min is clinically significant.
map.母体发热、用药（如宫缩抑制剂）、胎儿睡眠-觉醒周期、缺氧等均可改变基线，需结合变: Maternal fever, drugs (e.g. tocolytics), fetal sleep-wake cycle, hypoxia, etc. can shift the baseline; interpret with variability and decelerations.
